# xshield_field_values (Data Source)

The distinct values of one field, with the number of objects carrying each.

This answers "what values does this tag actually take in my tenant", which is the question a criteria depends on. The field must be facetable; `xshield_fields` reports which are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What values the environment tag actually takes, and how many assets carry each.
data "xshield_field_values" "environments" {
  field = "environment"
}

# Narrow the population first to see the values within one application.
data "xshield_field_values" "payroll_roles" {
  field    = "role"
  criteria = "application = 'payroll'"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `field` (String) Internal name of the field to summarise, for example `environment`.

### Optional

- `contains` (String) Return only values containing this text, matched case-insensitively.
- `criteria` (String) Narrow the population before counting. Defaults to every object in the scope.
- `scope` (String) Scope the field belongs to, for example `asset`. Defaults to the asset scope.

### Read-Only

- `has_more` (Boolean) True when the field has more distinct values than the API returned in one summary.
- `names` (List of String) The values alone, sorted, for use in a `for_each` or an `in` clause.
- `values` (Map of Number) Each value and the number of objects carrying it.
